description: Source code for Non-Volatile Storage (NVS) implementation in Zephyr RTOS, managing flash memory operations, including reading, writing, garbage collection, and cache management.

methods.name: nvs_prev_ate
methods.description: Retrieve the previous allocation table entry in the flash storage.

methods.name: nvs_ate_valid
methods.description: Validate an allocation table entry based on CRC and offset.

methods.name: nvs_lookup_cache_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuild the lookup cache for quick address retrieval.

methods.name: nvs_lookup_cache_invalidate
methods.description: Invalidate cache entries for a specific sector.

methods.name: nvs_al_size
methods.description: Calculate size aligned to write block size.

methods.name: nvs_flash_al_wrt
methods.description: Write data to flash with alignment.

methods.name: nvs_flash_rd
methods.description: Read data from flash.

methods.name: nvs_flash_ate_wrt
methods.description: Write an allocation table entry to flash.

methods.name: nvs_flash_data_wrt
methods.description: Write data to flash at the current data write address.

methods.name: nvs_flash_ate_rd
methods.description: Read an allocation table entry from flash.

methods.name: nvs_flash_block_cmp
methods.description: Compare flash data with a buffer.

methods.name: nvs_flash_cmp_const
methods.description: Compare flash data with a constant value.

methods.name: nvs_flash_block_move
methods.description: Move a block of data within flash.

methods.name: nvs_flash_erase_sector
methods.description: Erase a flash sector and verify.

methods.name: nvs_ate_crc8_update
methods.description: Update CRC8 checksum for an ATE.

methods.name: nvs_ate_crc8_check
methods.description: Check CRC8 checksum for an ATE.

methods.name: nvs_ate_cmp_const
methods.description: Compare an ATE with a constant value.

methods.name: nvs_ate_valid
methods.description: Validate an ATE based on CRC and offset.

methods.name: nvs_close_ate_valid
methods.description: Validate a sector close ATE.

methods.name: nvs_flash_wrt_entry
methods.description: Store an entry in flash.

methods.name: nvs_recover_last_ate
methods.description: Recover the last valid ATE in a sector.

methods.name: nvs_prev_ate
methods.description: Walk through the list of ATEs from newest to oldest.

methods.name: nvs_sector_advance
methods.description: Advance to the next sector.

methods.name: nvs_sector_close
methods.description: Close a sector by writing a sector close ATE.

methods.name: nvs_add_gc_done_ate
methods.description: Add a garbage collection done ATE.

methods.name: nvs_gc
methods.description: Perform garbage collection on flash sectors.

methods.name: nvs_startup
methods.description: Initialize the NVS filesystem on startup.

methods.name: nvs_clear
methods.description: Clear the entire NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_mount
methods.description: Mount and initialize the NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_write
methods.description: Write data associated with an ID into NVS.

methods.name: nvs_delete
methods.description: Delete an entry by ID.

methods.name: nvs_read_hist
methods.description: Read historical versions of an entry.

methods.name: nvs_read
methods.description: Read the latest version of an entry.

methods.name: nvs_calc_free_space
methods.description: Calculate free space in the NVS storage.
